description: This Swift source file defines a singleton enum 'GatewayLaunchAgentManager' responsible for managing the launch agent for a gateway service, including enabling/disabling launch agents, checking their status, and running related shell commands. It also extends functionality to parse daemon JSON responses and handle logs.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent write operation is disabled by the presence of a marker file.

methods.name: setLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Creates or removes a marker file to disable or enable launch agent writing.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the daemon is loaded by reading its JSON status.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent based on parameters, including remote mode check and write-disabled marker status.

methods.name: launchdConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current launch agent configuration.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Retrieves the log path for the gateway, prioritizing stdout, stderr, or default log location.

methods.name: readDaemonLoaded
methods.description: Internal async method that parses daemon status JSON to determine if the daemon is loaded.

methods.name: runDaemonCommand
methods.description: Runs a daemon command with specified arguments and timeout, returns an error message if it fails.

methods.name: runDaemonCommandResult
methods.description: Executes a shell command, parses JSON response, and returns success status, payload, and message.

methods.name: withJsonFlag
methods.description: Ensures '--json' flag is included in command arguments.

methods.name: parseDaemonJson
methods.description: Parses JSON string output from daemon commands into structured data.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Summarizes the last line of text from command response output for error detail.
